additional_info.subject: ID0411910-DC/Si-D/IL[170000903] - DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101 CRM:00315002433
additional_info.body:
Dear Orel, how are you?
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / P9 170000903
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
ZFNwm9
Problem Description
: DC2 is out of order due to CableTempSensor
Troubleshooting
: I checked the charger remotely and I see there is something wrong with the controller:
As you can see, the temperatures reading are 17kºC and 20kºC which is literally impossible unless we are near the sun :D
We also have the error
CBL:1 → in case of CAN Bus communication lost, this is the error responsible for the temperature error. We need to check where this communication is dropped here:
From here, you need to measure 3 points:
XD12:7B to XD12:8D
XD12:7A to XD12:8C
KF11 CAN 1L to KF11 CAN 1H
Measure directly on the connector screws
If we don't have 60Ohm in the first measurement it seems that the cables that come directly from the Microcontroller are broken or faulty and it needs replacement.
If we don't have 60Ohm between 7A and 8C that means that there is something wrong in this connector XD12.
If we don't have 60Ohm on the KF11 screws, then please try and use another spare connector from neighbour EcoG (usually there are some connectors in KF11/KF12 that are not used at all)
If we get 60Ohm until the KF11 and still we have the error, then we need to replace KF11.
Since the charger is out of warranty, please let me know what fits you best. I would recommend first to confirm if it's really the cable that needs replacement and then order it.
So I would say to go to site with a spare KF11 and try all these measurements above.
For future reference, your case number is
0411910
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
